title: Vietnam Golf Trip Cost 2027: Da Nang Fee Guide
content:
> **Executive Summary:** For Australian groups researching the cost of golf in Vietnam 2026, the Central Coast (Da Nang and Hoi An) offers the highest value-to-quality ratio in Asia. While individual green fees at premium championship links like Hoiana Shores Golf Club range from $380 to $450 AUD (6,300,000–7,500,000 VND) depending on seasonality, booking a fully managed "All-inclusive Vietnam golf holiday" through Asia Golf Specialists provides significant economies of scale. When factoring in mandatory caddy fees, private transfers, and luxury accommodation, a comprehensive 7-day, 4-round itinerary typically costs between $2,500 and $3,500 AUD per person (excluding flights). The most cost-effective approach for groups of 4 to 8 is bypassing traditional luxury golf resorts in favor of private beachfront villas along the An Bang coastline, which drastically reduces per-person accommodation expenses while delivering superior privacy and dedicated driver access to the region's elite layouts.
> 
> *Related: Compare the region in our [Vietnam vs. Thailand: 2026 Guide](/blog/vietnam-vs-thailand-golf-holiday/).*

**The True Cost of Golf in Vietnam: 2026 Da Nang Pricing Guide**

When planning a trip from Sydney, Melbourne, or Perth, the most common question we receive at Asia Golf Specialists is straightforward: what is the actual cost of golf in Vietnam 2026? 

The landscape has shifted. Vietnam is no longer a "cheap" budget destination; it is a premium championship hub that has claimed "Asia's Best Golf Destination" at the World Golf Awards for nine consecutive years. The courses in Da Nang and Hoi An rival the best in Australia, and the pricing reflects this global standing. However, when you bundle green fees, mandatory caddies, luxury accommodation, and private logistics into comprehensive [Vietnam golf packages](/destinations/vietnam/) from Australia, the value proposition remains unbeatable. Here is the unfiltered breakdown of what you can expect to spend on the Central Coast in 2026.

![Hoiana Shores Golf Club championship links course Da Nang green fees 2026](/images/courses/vietnam/vietnam-golf-course-hoiana-shores-championship-layout.webp)

## 1\. Green Fees: The Championship Premium

Unlike local Australian public courses, the championship layouts in Da Nang operate on a premium resort model. These are immaculate, world-class designs by Robert Trent Jones Jr., Greg Norman, and Luke Donald.

**At-a-Glance: 2026 Estimated Green Fees (Da Nang/Hoi An)**

| Course | Designer | Est. Green Fee (AUD) | Inclusions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hoiana Shores Golf Club | RTJ Jr. | $380 - $450 | 18 Holes, Caddy, Shared Cart |
| Ba Na Hills Golf Club | Luke Donald | $240 - $300 | 18 Holes, Caddy, Shared Cart |
| BRG Da Nang (Norman) | Greg Norman | $220 - $280 | 18 Holes, Caddy, Shared Cart |
| Montgomerie Links | Colin Montgomerie | $210 - $260 | 18 Holes, Caddy, Shared Cart |

*Note: Rates fluctuate based on the day of the week, seasonality (February to September is peak), and direct vs. operator booking rates. AGS secures wholesale rates for all managed itineraries.*

![Ba Na Hills Golf Club floodlit night golf Da Nang Vietnam green fees](/images/courses/vietnam/vietnam-golf-course-ba-na-hills-championship-layout.webp)

## 2\. The Hidden Advantage: Mandatory Caddies

In Vietnam, caddies are mandatory. While this might initially seem like an added cost to an Australian golfer accustomed to carrying their own bag or pulling a buggy, it is actually the greatest value multiplier of the trip.

Your green fee covers the caddy's base rate. However, tipping is standard practice and expected. 

*   **Standard Caddy Tip:** 400,000 to 500,000 VND (approx. $25–$30 AUD) per round.

For $30 AUD, you receive a dedicated local expert who reads your putts on unfamiliar Champion grass, calculates yardage adjusting for coastal wind, rakes every bunker, and carries your clubs. In terms of improving your game and the overall luxury experience, it is the best $30 you will spend all week.

![BRG Da Nang Golf Resort Norman Course ocean views Vietnam golf packages](/images/courses/vietnam/vietnam-golf-course-brg-da-nang-norman-championship-layout.webp)

## 3\. Accommodation: Luxury Resorts vs. Private Beachfront Villas

Where you sleep dictates the overall cost of your trip more than where you play. For an all-inclusive Vietnam golf holiday, you have two primary options:

**Option A: Five-Star Golf Resorts**
Properties like the InterContinental Danang or Banyan Tree Lang Co offer incredible luxury but come with international luxury price tags (often $400–$800+ AUD per night per room). If you have a group of 8 guys requiring single-occupancy rooms, this rapidly inflates the trip's cost.

**Option B: The AGS Private Beachfront Villa (The Value Play)**
This is Asia Golf Specialists' core differentiator. For groups of 4 to 8, we secure private, fully-staffed beachfront villas along the An Bang and Cua Dai coastline in Hoi An. 
*   **The Math:** Instead of paying for 8 separate hotel rooms, the group splits the cost of a sprawling 6-to-8 bedroom luxury villa. 
*   **The Result:** Per-person accommodation costs drop dramatically, while privacy, communal space (private pools, living areas for evening drinks), and proximity to the beach increase. You are also situated right on the doorstep of Hoiana Shores and just 30 minutes from the Da Nang courses.

![Vietnam luxury accommodation beachfront private villa Hoi An 2026](/images/accommodations/vietnam/banyan-tree-lang-co/vietnam-luxury-hotel-banyan-tree-lang-co-resort-5-star-recovery.webp)

## 4\. Transport and Logistics

Do not attempt to rely on ad-hoc taxis with eight golf bags. An "escorted golf tours Vietnam" package through AGS includes a dedicated, air-conditioned VIP transit van and a driver on standby.

If booking independently, renting a private 16-seater van for a week with a driver typically runs between $600 and $900 AUD total for the week. When divided by a group of eight, the cost of seamless, stress-free transport from the villa to the first tee is negligible.

![Montgomerie Links Vietnam golf course Da Nang 2026 pricing](/images/courses/vietnam/vietnam-golf-course-montgomerie-links-championship-layout.webp)

## 5\. Gastronomy: The 19th Hole and Beyond

Food and beverage costs in Central Vietnam represent exceptional value, offsetting the premium green fees. 
*   **Local Street Food & Casual Dining:** $5–$15 AUD per meal.
*   **Premium Dining in Hoi An:** A spectacular multi-course dinner at one of the top restaurants in Hoi An's Ancient Town, accompanied by cocktails and imported wine, rarely exceeds $60–$90 AUD per head.
*   **Beer:** A local Bia Huda or Larue will cost you around $2–$3 AUD, even in nice establishments.

## The Verdict: DIY vs. AGS Golf Package

Can you book everything yourself? Yes. Will it save you money? Rarely. 

Because AGS operates locally on the ground in Hoi An, we secure wholesale rates on tee times, villas, and transport that are unavailable to the public. More importantly, we manage the logistics. We ensure your tee times at Hoiana Shores are booked early to beat the wind, your driver is waiting at the airport, and your villa is stocked with cold beers upon arrival.

**Total Estimated Budget (7 Days, 4 Rounds, Premium Villa, Transfers):** Expect to invest between **$2,500 and $3,500 AUD per person** (land only). For world-class championship golf, private luxury accommodation, and VIP service, it remains one of the greatest travel values in the global game.

***

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q? What is the cost of a round of golf in Da Nang for 2026?**
A. Green fees at Da Nang's top championship courses range from approximately $210 AUD to $450 AUD (3,500,000 to 7,500,000 VND). This premium pricing includes 18 holes, a shared golf cart, and a mandatory caddy. Hoiana Shores Golf Club represents the upper end of this pricing tier.

**Q? Are caddies included in the green fee in Vietnam?**
A. The base fee for the caddy is included in your green fee or golf package. However, it is mandatory and culturally expected to tip your caddy directly at the end of the round. The standard tip in 2026 is between 400,000 and 500,000 VND (roughly $25 to $30 AUD).

**Q? Is it cheaper to book an all-inclusive Vietnam golf holiday or pay individually?**
A. Booking a managed golf package through an operator like Asia Golf Specialists is almost always more cost-effective. Operators access wholesale green fees and accommodation rates, and bundling private transport prevents the escalating costs and logistical nightmares of moving groups and golf bags via local taxis.

**Q? What is the best time of year to play golf in Da Nang to maximize value?**
A. The optimal window for weather is February through September. While December and January might offer slightly cheaper "off-peak" rates, the high risk of monsoon rain on the Central Coast makes it a false economy. To guarantee playing conditions, stick to the Australian autumn and winter months.

**Q? How much should I budget per day for food and drinks in Hoi An?**
A. For a premium but relaxed experience, budgeting $60 to $100 AUD per day is more than sufficient. This covers excellent local coffee, casual lunches, and high-end dinners in Hoi An Ancient Town with alcoholic beverages.

faqs.q: What is the average green fee for championship golf in Da Nang in 2026/27?
faqs.a: All-inclusive 18-hole rates (covering green fee, personal 1-on-1 caddie fee, and shared motorized cart) across Da Nang's top courses—Hoiana Shores, Ba Na Hills, BRG Da Nang Norman/Nicklaus, and Montgomerie Links—range from $145 to $220 USD on weekdays and $185 to $260 USD on weekends.

faqs.q: Are caddie tips included in pre-paid Vietnam golf packages?
faqs.a: The base caddie fee is included in your Asia Golf Specialists package, while the customary post-round cash tip of 400,000 to 500,000 VND ($20–$25 USD per round) is paid directly by the golfer to their caddie at the 18th green.

faqs.q: Why do weekend tee times cost $35 to $50 USD more per round in Da Nang?
faqs.a: Vietnamese championship clubs apply weekend and public-holiday tariffs on Saturdays and Sundays due to high domestic member demand; scheduling your four marquee rounds between Monday and Friday saves approximately $150–$200 USD per golfer while guaranteeing quieter fairways.
